findings.details: [P1] Preserve complete longer Secret matches when combining inspected patterns with literals. The new union prepends every inspected pattern ahead of length-sorted literal variants. If selected Secret B starts with the inspected representation of selected Secret A, A's shorter regex consumes that prefix before the complete literal B can match. Independent native reproduction selects A='overlap-small-head\nshorter-secret-tail' and B=inspect(A,{breakLength:1})+'-longer-credential-unmasked-suffix-920371', then writes B unchanged using process.stderr.write(process.env.LONGER). Persisted run.error, execution.error, events, inspect and raw records contain [REDACTED]-longer-credential-unmasked-suffix-920371. This is a complete known Secret echoed without a runtime transformation; D3/AC3/AC7 require masking it before history. The prior562671e redactor fully masks the same raw B, confirming regression. Preserve full-match coverage across overlapping representations and add a multi-secret native regression. Proof /tmp/interlock-review-577f285-overlap.{mts,json,log} and /tmp/interlock-review-577f285-overlap-baseline.{mts,log}; both separate passes independently reproduced.
